purpose: Native stock LibreOffice 26.8 comparison: does a forward delete that leaves caret geometry unchanged emit any documented LOK callback?
why: All prior 016 evidence came from the headless --disable-gui WASM profile. findings/README.md requires reproducing on an upstream-default configuration before filing upstream.

localWorktreeModifications: solenv/gbuild/platform/unxgcc.mk (inert: entire hunk is inside $(if $(filter EMSCRIPTEN,$(OS)),...))
vcl/qt5/QtFrame.cxx (NOT compiled: ENABLE_QT5=0, ENABLE_QT6=0 in this build)
core.comparisonCleanliness: No local modification reaches this build. Verified against config_host/config_vclplug.h.

build.note: GUI backends left enabled (ENABLE_GTK3=1) and svp selected at runtime, matching how Collabora Online runs LibreOfficeKit. A --disable-gui build would have left a negative result ambiguous.

run.note: The probe does NOT call runLoop(); see the analysis for why this matters.

validity.control: Caret move produced INVALIDATE_VISIBLE_CURSOR and TEXT_SELECTION, proving the callback channel was alive before the measured step.
validity.note: A run in which the delete did not land would prove nothing about callback absence; the probe marks such runs DISCARD.

unoCommandResult.note: wasModified sits beside saveDurationMics and appears to describe save state, not content change. Not relied upon.

timing.note: Deferred callbacks arrive roughly 600ms AFTER the command result, i.e. they are idle/scheduler driven.

wasmComparison.note: Native emits .uno:Bold=false; the WASM profile never observed one, so the deferred STATE_CHANGED stream does not reach it at all.
wasmComparison.engineGrep: probe_engine.cpp contains no Yield, Scheduler, ProcessEventsToIdle or emscripten_sleep

coolReference.coreReads: desktop/source/lib/init.cxx:8083 reads SAL_LOK_OPTIONS (COOL sets SAL_KIT_OPTIONS; the names differ and the core-side name governs)

conclusion.reframedAs: project execution model omits the LibreOfficeKit main loop that deferred callbacks depend on
conclusion.confidence: inference, not yet observed: pumping the loop in the WASM engine has not been tried
conclusion.openQuestion: Native emitted zero INVALIDATE_TILES even after a 1500ms drain. Unexplained; not used to support the conclusion.
